articles.description: Teams aren’t waiting until after the impending lockout to reinforce their rosters. But will the Dodgers be among those teams before the current CBA expires on Dec. 1?
articles.title: MLB free agent market is active, even with a looming lockout. Will Dodgers make a splash?

articles.description: Shohei Ohtani’s two-way skillset is so unique that any time he pitches and hits for an entire season, he’s practically guaranteed the MVP. What did the Dodgers learn this past year?
articles.title: Shohei Ohtani lost the MVP to Pete Crow-Armstrong. What he needs to do to reclaim it
